safetyTips: 🤝 Learn the Heimlich maneuver for choking victims.
💧 For burns, run cool water over the area for at least 10 minutes. Avoid ice.
🩹 Apply firm, direct pressure to a wound to control bleeding.
❤️‍🩹 Know how to perform hands-only CPR for adults.
🛡️ If someone is having a seizure, clear the area and protect their head. Do not restrain them.
🧠 Stay with someone who has a head injury and monitor their consciousness.
⚡ Remember the FAST acronym for a stroke: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call 911.
🩺 If you think someone is having a heart attack, call an ambulance immediately.
👃 For a nosebleed, lean forward and pinch the soft part of the nose for 10-15 minutes.
🧊 In case of a sprain, remember RICE: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation.
⚠️ Always check for danger to yourself before approaching an injured person.
🛑 Never pull out an object that is impaled in a wound.
⛑️ Keep a well-stocked first-aid kit at home and in your car.
🔥 In a fire, 'Stop, Drop, and Roll' if your clothes catch fire.
🧯 When using a fire extinguisher, remember PASS: Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep.
😴 If someone faints, lay them down and elevate their legs slightly.
🦴 For a broken bone, immobilize the area and apply a cold compress.
📞 Know the emergency numbers in your area.
🚗 In a car accident, stay in your vehicle until it's safe to exit.
🥤 Stay hydrated, even if you are not thirsty, especially in hot weather.
🥵 If someone has heat stroke, cool them down with water and ice packs.
🧼 Keep children away from cleaning products and medicines.
💊 Always read the instructions on medications before taking them.
🔦 Use flashlights instead of candles during a power outage.
💨 Install smoke and carbon monoxide detectors on every floor of your home.
🌿💀 Learn to identify poisonous plants in your region.
🐍 For a snakebite, keep the person calm and still. Do not try to suck out the venom.
🔪 When using a knife, always cut away from your body.
🏊🚫 Never swim alone or in unsupervised areas.
👁️ For an eye injury, flush with clean water for 15 minutes and seek medical attention.
⚡️ If you are shocked by electricity, do not touch the person until the power is off.
💉 Administer an EpiPen immediately if someone is having a severe allergic reaction.
✨ For a minor cut, wash with soap and water, apply an antiseptic, and cover with a bandage.
🫥 Never give an unconscious person food or drink.
💪 When providing CPR, push hard and fast in the center of the chest.
😵 Know how to recognize the signs of shock: pale, cool skin, rapid pulse, weakness.
🗓️ Keep your tetanus vaccination up to date.
🦷 If a tooth is knocked out, place it in milk or saliva and see a dentist immediately.
⛈️ Stay indoors during a thunderstorm to avoid lightning strikes.
🗺️ If you are lost, stay put and signal for help.
🚰 Know the location of your home’s main water valve and electrical panel.
🔗 Always wear a seatbelt when in a vehicle.
👦👧 Teach children what to do if they get lost in a public place.
⚠️🔥 Keep all flammable materials away from heat sources.
❤️ Learn how to use a defibrillator (AED) if one is available.
🩸 If someone is bleeding heavily from an arm or leg, you may need a tourniquet.
🗑️ Store sharps like needles in a rigid, sealed container.
👥 In a crowd, stay near the exits and have a meeting place in case of a separation.
🤕 If you suspect a concussion, rest is critical. Avoid physical and mental strain.
🔫 Never assume a gun is unloaded. Handle all firearms as if they are loaded.
✂️ Store sharp objects properly to avoid cuts.
💨 In a fire, crawl low to the ground to avoid smoke.
🌡️ Check water temperature before bathing children to prevent burns.
👶 If a child is choking, perform back blows and chest thrusts.
💧 Recognize the signs of dehydration: dizziness, dry mouth, dark urine.
📌 For a splinter, sterilize tweezers and pull it out gently.
🕯️ Never leave a candle or stove unattended.
📇 Keep a list of emergency contacts visible for others to see.
🧯 Learn the location of all fire extinguishers in your home.
📞 Teach children to call a trusted adult or emergency services in a crisis.
🏞️ If you're lost, follow a stream or river downhill.
👕 Wear bright clothing when walking or cycling at night.
⛑️ Always wear a helmet when cycling or skating.
☀️ Use sunscreen with at least SPF 30.
🦑 For jellyfish stings, rinse with vinegar or saltwater, not fresh water.
🌊 In case of a flood, go to the highest point in your home.
🏠 Know the safe zones in your home for severe weather.
🥶 For frostbite, slowly rewarm the affected area with body heat or warm water.
💊👶 Never give medicine to a child without checking the correct dose.
🔋 Keep a backup power source, like a portable charger, for your phone.
🐶 For a dog bite, wash the wound with soap and water and see a doctor.
🌍 In an earthquake, 'Drop, Cover, and Hold On.'
👁️ If you get something in your eye, don't rub it. Flush with water.
🥽 Always wear goggles for eye protection when using power tools.
🤧 For a severe allergic reaction, remove the trigger and call for help.
😵 Learn to recognize the signs of a concussion: dizziness, headache, nausea.
🥾 When hiking, always tell someone your route and expected return time.
🧪 Never mix cleaning products, especially bleach and ammonia.
🤯 If a person is in shock, keep them warm and comfortable.
🩹 For a minor burn, cover it with a sterile bandage to prevent infection.
🛡️ Learn how to use a fire blanket.
🚫🔥 Keep matches and lighters out of reach of children.
🐝 For a bee sting, scrape the stinger out with a credit card. Don't use tweezers.
💓 Know how to check a person's pulse and breathing.
⛈️ In a severe storm, unplug electronics to protect them from power surges.
⚡ Always stay clear of downed power lines.
🤕 For a simple fracture, apply a splint and go to the hospital.
🔔 Carry a personal alarm or whistle for emergencies.
🗣️ Learn a few words in the local language for 'help' or 'doctor' when traveling.
🚗 Check car tires, oil, and water before a long trip.
🥵 In a severe heat wave, seek out an air-conditioned space.
💊 Keep a list of all your medications and dosages.
🥶 For hypothermia, remove wet clothing and warm the person slowly.
⛽ Keep your car's gas tank at least half-full in winter.
💨 In case of a gas leak, open windows and evacuate immediately. Do not turn lights on or off.
🚫⚡ Never put metal in a microwave.
👃 For a foreign object in the nose, encourage the person to breathe through their mouth.
🩸 Know your blood type.
🚗 If you see an abandoned vehicle, report it to the authorities.
🧠 Trust your instincts. If a situation feels unsafe, leave.
